processing: Fixed 5x2 grid extraction and normalization to 400x400 with ImageMagick. No painted effects added by code.

families.name: shard
families.description: thin jagged fragments of dark obsidian, triangular slivers, spear-shaped chips, curved chips, fractured wedges; ONE single piece per cell

object.brief: thin jagged fragments of dark obsidian, triangular slivers, spear-shaped chips, curved chips, fractured wedges; ONE single piece per cell; dark material, no magical cracks or glow, five columns by two rows, transparent alpha

cracks.prompt: Produce a SEPARATE SURFACE CRACK DECAL atlas from this shard reference. Same exact 5 columns x 2 rows grid on wide 5:2 canvas, same ten object positions. Remove all objects: only ten clusters of thin DARK CHARCOAL fissure linework, narrow gray bevel at edges, remain on transparent alpha. These are NON-EMISSIVE dry physical cracks, like fine ink hairlines; ABSOLUTELY NO blue, no luminescence, no bloom, no aura, no smoke, no glow, no filled stone silhouettes. Each cluster is one short jagged central crack with 2-3 fine short branches confined to the INNER MIDDLE HALF of its original object. Crack line thickness about 1 to 3 pixels at 400pixel cell scale. Do not span full width of cells, no background or shadows or labels. Everything except the tiny thin fissure strokes must be transparent. The colored illumination will be provided in a DIFFERENT asset, so this atlas MUST remain achromatic, dark gray fine linework only. Retain original cell alignment.

glow.prompt: Make a matching GLOW ONLY alpha sprite atlas for the ten shard objects in this reference. Keep exact wide 5:2 canvas, FIVE columns TWO rows grid, and all ten silhouette locations and orientations. Remove EVERY solid object. Only a delicate transparent wisp of PALE ICY BLUE and a hint of desaturated mint fog around the silhouette perimeter remains. Hollow completely transparent interior; softly feathered translucent outer aura. Each aura confined to its cell with generous transparent padding. Thin wispy contour not a thick neon line, low intensity, dark fantasy game card effects. NO surface cracks, NO lightning, NO sharp internal strokes, NO stars, NO rocks, NO gemstones, NO opaque shapes, NO white filled centers, NO ground shadows, NO background, NO labels or grid. Separate reusable gentle edge glow overlay on actual transparent alpha.
